answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. A prism of per-task receipts records who did what, and the tide of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The cedar of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
